exam_scheme.note: Direct recruitment examination for Staff Nurses conducted by the Medical Services Recruitment Board (MRB) consists of a single objective written paper in Nursing subjects along with a mandatory qualifying Tamil Language Eligibility Test. No viva-voce or interview is conducted; selections are based strictly on written examination merit and the statutory communal reservation roster.

stages.source_label: TN MRB Notification No. 02/MRB/2019, Section 7: Scheme of Examination (Objective Type)

papers.paper_name: Mandatory Tamil Eligibility Test (SSLC Standard, 50 Questions)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 40% (20 marks); mandatory qualifying examination as per G.O. Ms. No. 133, Human Resources Management Department

papers.paper_name: Core Nursing Subject Paper (Diploma / Degree in Nursing Standard, 200 MCQs)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum qualifying mark: 30% (30 marks) for SC, SCA, and ST; 35% (35 marks) for Other categories (each question carries 0.5 mark)

financial_package.note: Nurses recruited through MRB are initially placed on a consolidated contractual pay of ₹14,000 per month (with annual increments of ₹500 under G.O. Ms. No. 232, Health and Family Welfare Department). Following completion of two years of satisfactory service, candidates are absorbed into the regular time-scale under Level 10 of the Tamil Nadu Revised Pay Matrix (₹20,600 - ₹75,900).
financial_package.pay_source_label: TN MRB Notification No. 02/MRB/2019, Section 4: Scale of Pay & G.O. (Ms). No. 232, Health and Family Welfare Department
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimate reflects regular time-scale emoluments post-absorption at Level 10 entry basic pay ₹20,600 with 58% DA (effective 1 Jul 2025) plus Tamil Nadu Grade-classified HRA (₹1,200 to ₹3,000), Medical Allowance, Uniform Allowance, and Night Shift Duty Allowance. Deductions include CPS (10% of Basic+DA), NHIS, and professional tax.
official_perks: Medical insurance coverage under New Health Insurance Scheme (NHIS) for nurses and dependent family members
Uniform Allowance, Washing Allowance, and Night Duty Special Allowance
Staff quarters inside government hospital campuses or station HRA
Earned leave, maternity leave, and medical leave benefits under Tamil Nadu Fundamental Rules
Absorption into permanent government service with Contributory Pension Scheme benefits

competition_benchmarks.note: The TN MRB Staff Nurse Examination is the primary recruitment mechanism for clinical nursing posts across hundreds of government medical institutions in Tamil Nadu, drawing tens of thousands of GNM and B.Sc. Nursing registered candidates per cycle.
